general.title: About Server Eggs
general.desc:
**Server Eggs** is a Discord bot created by **Flamey** (actuallyflamey).
It is designed as a fun way to share content, from which someone may want to join its origin server.
general.about_desc:
An **Egg** is some text, an attachment (through file or URL), or both.
When an **Egg** is created, it is accessible from any server with **Server Eggs**.
general.how_desc:
- To **create an Egg**, use `/create` in a server.
  - The `text` argument **adds text** to the Egg.
  - The `file` argument **adds an attachment** as a file.
  - The `link` argument **adds an attachment** as a URL.
  - *In NSFW channels*, you can create a **NSFW Egg** and mark it with `nsfw:True`.
- To **receive** an Egg, use `/get`.
general.beta_desc: Because **Server Eggs** is in **beta**, all data from this beta will be deleted once it ends.
